items.item: Uses a Named Credential (callout:...) instead of a hard-coded URL or credentials
items.evidence: private static final String ENDPOINT = 'callout:ERP/api/orders'; no hard-coded erp.example.com in the code

items.item: Makes the callout asynchronously (Queueable with Database.AllowsCallouts or @future(callout=true)), not directly in the trigger transaction
items.evidence: public with sharing class OrderErpSyncJob implements Queueable, Database.AllowsCallouts; the trigger's afterSave calls System.enqueueJob(new OrderErpSyncJob(ids))

items.item: Includes a test that uses HttpCalloutMock with Test.setMock, covering a failure response
items.evidence: ErpMock implements HttpCalloutMock; failureResponseIsStoredOnTheOrder calls Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new ErpMock(500)) and asserts 'Failed'
